seo.title: Grey & Ductile Iron Castings Supplier India – EN-GJL / EN-GJS | Asian Technocast
seo.description: Iron foundry in Rajkot, India, since 2006. Motor frames, end shields, pump casings and gearbox housings in EN-GJL and EN-GJS grades, machined in-house and shipped FOB/CIF.

headline: Grey & ductile iron castings, machined in-house, exported from India.
subhead: Motor frames, end shields, pump casings and gearbox housings made to your drawing in EN-GJL and EN-GJS grades (EN 1561 / EN 1563). Shipped FOB or CIF from Mundra or Pipavav.

productsIntro: Grey and ductile iron parts made to customer drawings, supplied as-cast or machined and painted.

industries.title: Electric motors
industries.text: Stator housings (motor frames) and end shields for NEMA and IEC frame motors.

industries.title: Pumps & irrigation
industries.text: Volute casings, pump bodies and covers for water and irrigation pumps.

industries.title: Power transmission
industries.text: Gearbox and gear housings, covers and bearing carriers.

industries.title: Agricultural equipment
industries.text: Castings for tractors, implements and farm machinery.

industries.title: Automotive aftermarket
industries.text: Cylinder heads and replacement iron castings made to drawing.

why.title: One supplier: casting + machining
why.text: Casting, CNC/VMC machining and painting under one roof, so you get finished parts with one point of contact.

why.title: Grades you specify
why.text: We work to EN 1561 / EN 1563 grades, with ASTM and IS equivalents cross-referenced for your drawing.

why.title: Documented quality
why.text: Material test certificates and dimensional reports, with first-article inspection or PPAP on request.

why.title: Export-ready packing
why.text: ISPM-15 heat-treated wooden crates and pallets, shipped FOB or CIF from Gujarat ports.

why.title: Direct contact with the owners
why.text: You talk to the people who run the foundry, by email, phone or WhatsApp.

why.title: Fast replies
why.text: We reply within 24 hours (IST). Our working day overlaps the UK and European morning.

ctaTitle: Send your drawing for a quote
ctaText: PDF, STEP, DWG or DXF. Tell us the grade, annual quantity and delivery target, and we will reply within 24 hours (IST).
